claimed_state: Both frozen finite wings were evaluated on M2/N4 and M4/N8 at the same accepted closure length and finite core. The product coefficients and original residuals agree with their corresponding independent finite solutions. The larger independent observations and the native dense-interval payload quantify separate open common-limit and resource requirements.

verification.windows: Windows 11、MSVC 14.51 Releaseの新旧6件が通過した。M2/N4は各563検査、水平13.58秒、上反角5度18.86秒。M4/N8は各1,647検査、水平103.69秒、上反角5度137.87秒。従来の定常2件は各13,447検査。
verification.linux: Linux、GCC 14.2.0 Releaseの新旧6件が通過した。M2/N4は水平7.69秒、上反角5度10.07秒。M4/N8は水平81.66秒、上反角5度94.40秒。数値検査数はWindowsと一致し、従来の定常・コアと今回の細分の代表3構成でclang-tidyが通過した。
verification.build_notes: Windows Debugの上反角5度・M4/N8は先行版でコンパイルした。ここに示す実行時間と確保量はReleaseの観測値である。
commands: clang-tidy --quiet with the fixed compile command for representative steady, core-radius and M4/N8 refinement tests
verification.mutation: With the retained downstream strengths replaced by zero in a separate binary, the fixed-point original residual exceeded the threshold. Unchanged binary passes.
verification.scope: Native fixed-tail load solve followed by fixed-point re-evaluation with its own retained strengths. Near/far comparison on the same geometry and comparison to the frozen reference limit remain separate. No full-grid timing or process peak is inferred.
